tonight.headline: Up 21.6 with three starters still to play — the first win of the season is close
body: Bad news first: C.J. Stroud's 23.0 is on your bench, Rashee Rice is out again with no return date, and Garrett Wilson finished with 8.4. Matt Gay had 7 at the half.

Nothing to do. Los Cachanillas have no starter left to kick off — only Adams, Dicker and Cousins finishing the late games — while you still have Golden and Pickens tonight and Daniels on Monday, 48.2 projected. ESPN: 99%. At 0-5, this would be the first win.

case.label: Why nothing
case.body: Golden and Pickens are not on either report (Packers.com 16 Oct), and Daniels is not on Washington's (Yahoo 17 Oct). The only unlocked bench players are Jacobs, ineligible until 25 Oct (AP 16 Oct), and Gordon, on bye — so a scratch could not be covered anyway.

case.label: The bench points
case.body: Stroud's 23.0 against a Monday quarterback is the price of a projection that said Daniels by 4.2. It is graded on Monday's result, not on Stroud's.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Golden or Pickens inactive at 16:50 CDMX tonight, or Daniels at 16:45 Monday. Uncoverable; the lead would still probably hold.

case.label: The bye
case.body: Washington (Daniels) and Jacksonville (Tuten) are on bye in Week 7 (ESPN file); Houston's is Week 8. Stroud was added on 17 Oct as this cover and threw three touchdowns in London today (archive, 23.0).

case.label: The running back
case.body: Tuten's slot goes to Jacobs or Gordon on Tuesday's Week 7 projection. Jacobs comes off the exempt list Monday and is eligible at Detroit on 25 Oct, but the league's conduct review continues (AP 16 Oct) and his first-game workload is unknown.

case.label: Not an override
case.body: A bye is a zero; this is a forced move, and it waits until Daniels has played Monday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Stroud is ruled out for Week 7, or Week 7 projections put a free quarterback more than two points above him and the swap is made anyway.

worthALook.name: Tyler Allgeier
worthALook.lead: KEI returns dropped him at 07:55 UTC; he is on waivers until Wednesday 01:00 CDMX.

case.label: The player
case.body: Arizona's lead back this week with Jeremiyah Love ruled out (ankle); Bam Knight is the only other back (Fantasy Footballers 16 Oct). The wire screen gives him 80% of Love's vacated share.

case.label: Checked this run
case.body: Re-checked 22:20Z: started and had 15 touches for 4.7 late in the game, with Bam Knight on 14 for 11.3 (live archive). No injury reported (CBS tracker). Still on IPADE waivers until Wed 01:00 CDMX. The split weakens the case, not strengthens it.

case.label: Why not a claim
case.body: Love is re-evaluated daily and Arizona say there is 'no discussion of IR' (TSN 16 Oct) — this is a handcuff while Love is out. A claim in IPADE drops you to last for the season, and STRATEGY forbids spending it on a patch or a handcuff. Tuten's Week 7 bye is already covered by Jacobs (eligible) and Gordon (back from bye).

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if Love is ruled out for Week 7 or placed on IR and Jacobs's return is delayed by further discipline — then reconsider Tuesday with the drop named.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love misses Weeks 7-8 and Allgeier, unclaimed, outscores Gordon in both.
